build_gpt2_coreml_model: build a Core ML model from a HuggingFace GPT-2 transformer using NeuralNetworkBuilder
convert_gpt2_to_mlmodel: convert a pretrained GPT-2 model to a Core ML .mlmodel file for on-device inference
extract_gpt2_weights: extract token and positional embedding weights from a GPT-2 model as numpy arrays
build_attention_layers_coreml: build self-attention layers with QKV projections and softmax using Core ML NeuralNetworkBuilder
save_coreml_spec: save a Core ML model specification to a .mlmodel file using save_spec
